evidence_contract.docstring: gp154_scaling_law_normalized is cage_meta.class=nd_features. Each row is a feature dict; target is z_normalized_excess_loss in [0,1].

persona: You are an adversarial epistemic auditor. This substrate is NOT raw-loss prediction. It tests whether neural scaling curves share a compact normalized shape after per-curve floor/amplitude gauge removal. The target is z=(L-L_min(curve))/(L_max(curve)-L_min(curve)), a bounded coordinate in [0,1]. Gate metrics use mean absolute error, not relative error. Reject lookup tables over study/source_paper_table/curve_id. Reject hidden numeric defaults inside PARAMETRIC_FORM. v3.1 baseline to beat: z=curve_axis_rev^alpha_axis with alpha_MIXED≈3.45, alpha_N≈1.46, alpha_D≈1.48; it passes holdout and farther-tail offline. Reward candidates that beat this baseline, reduce its K, or mechanize why mixed compute-frontier curves have a steeper exponent than pure N/D sweeps. A Lagrangian/free-energy story is admissible only if it produces an executable closed-form I_model.

dimensions.name: Normalized Invariant Discovery
dimensions.description: Find a compact closed-form predictor for z_normalized_excess_loss using curve geometry. Full credit requires K<=8, no curve/source lookup, and a transferable shape law.

dimensions.name: Holdout Validation
dimensions.description: HOLDOUT MAE < 0.08 on Chinchilla/Kaplan normalized targets using gate_harness.py.

dimensions.name: Farther-Tail Transfer
dimensions.description: FARTHER_TAIL MAE < 0.15 on all Hestness/Henighan normalized targets. Passing supports shape transfer after gauge removal.

dimensions.name: Anti-Memorization Discipline
dimensions.description: No branching over study, source_paper_table, curve_id, or hidden numeric defaults. Effective parameter count must match declared K.

dimensions.name: Generative Yield + Variational Mechanism
dimensions.description: Optional but rewarded: derive the curve-shape law from a concrete variational/free-energy or RG-style principle that yields the executable form.

dimensions.name: Rival Skepticism
dimensions.description: Compare against at least two rivals, including z=curve_axis_rev and the v3.1 axis-conditioned exponent family.

criteria.Normalized_Invariant_Discovery: Compact closed-form z predictor, K<=8 preferred, no curve lookup.
criteria.Anti_Memorization_Discipline: No study/source/curve lookup; no hidden defaults.
criteria.Variational_Mechanistic_Yield: Executable variational or RG-style derivation if claimed.
criteria.Rival_Skepticism: At least two rival forms tested, including the v3.1 axis-conditioned exponent baseline.
